title: ELITES AND THE GOLDEN ENEMY ARE ONE FAMILY
why: His answer on the elites asked for them to sit well beside the golden enemy. The golden enemy and the elite pillagers now wear the same clean outline and faint tint as an elite machine, in gold and in the pillager purple, so every special enemy reads the same way and none of them clash.
now: The golden enemy and elite pillagers now wear the same coloured outline as the elite machines.

edits.replacement: _rm=rimOpen(e2,rimColour(e2));   // v26.xx (aip1, aip3): the outline of an elite or the golden enemy
